questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered 1, 2 and 3. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Each tissue is a bone.

All ligaments are bones.

All bones are muscles.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some muscles are ligaments.

2. All tissues are muscles.

3. No bone is a ligament.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/627a58f718fcc6a8e9c578838ef9d534927ef7019788f9cab6a7da33ed7dbeb1.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some muscles are ligaments → True (As Some part of muscles is ligament)

2. All tissues are muscles → True (As Each tissue is a bone and All bones are muscles)

3. No bone is a ligament→ False (As All ligament become Bone)

Hence, **Only conclusions 1 and 2 follow.**

Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

G _ R _ M _ K R C _ G K _ C M
questions.solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) G **__*R*__** R ***__C__*** M / ***__G__*** K R C ***__R__*** / G K __**G**__ C M → doesn't follow a pattern

2) G __***K***__ R __***C***__ M / __***G***__ K R C __***M***__ / G K __**R**__ C M → follow a pattern

3) G __***K***__ R __***G***__ M / __***G***__ K R C __***R***__ / G K __**M**__ C M → doesn't follow a pattern

4) G __***K***__ R __***C***__ M / __***C***__ K R C __***M***__ / G K __**G**__ C M → doesn't follow a pattern

Hence,** "K C G M R"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letter that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

c _ _ r n _ c f _ r n p _ f x _ n p

options.text: x f p x n r
f p c x r c
f x r n c p
f x p x c r

questions.solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) c __***x f***__ r n __***p***__ / c f __***x***__ r n p / __***n***__ f x ***__r__*** n p → doesn't follow a pattern

2) c ***__f p__*** r n ***__c__*** c / f ***__x__*** r n p ***__r__*** / f x ***__c__*** n p → doesn't follow a pattern

3) c ***__f x__*** r n ***__r__*** / c f ***__n__*** r n p / ***__c__*** f x ***__p__*** n p → doesn't follow a pattern

4) c ***__f x__*** r n ***__p__*** / c f ***__x__*** r n p / ***__c__*** f x ***__r__*** n p → follow a pattern

Hence,** "f x p x c r"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: 'East' is related to 'West' in the same way as 'North-east' is related to '______

Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

21, 43, 45, 91, 93, ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

(21 × 2) + 1 = 43

43 + 2 = 45

(45 × 2) + 1 = 91

91 + 2 = 93 

(93 × 2) + 1 = 187

Hence, **"187"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a code language. If CHAIR is written as 25 and BOTTLE is written as 36, then how will CAUTION be written in the same language?
questions.solution:
**Logic:** (Number of letters)²

CHAIR → number of letters is 5

= 5² = 25

BOTTLE → number of letters is 6

= 62 = 36

CAUTION → number of letters is 7

= 72 = 49

Hence, **"49"** is the correct answer.
